batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c Shakib Al Hasan b CV Varun

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c RA Tripathi b LH Ferguson

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b Avesh Khan

batting.name: VR Iyer
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b K Rabada

batting.name: N Rana
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b A Nortje

batting.name: SP Narine
batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b R Ashwin

balls.text: the no-look six! And Iyer crashes that on to the roof, as the ball lands back downstairs after striking up. Iyer stays deep in his crease, and he gets a full-toss on middle and off, to which he presents the full face of the bat to crash it over the bowler's head for the maximum. A good final over for Capitals, with 15 off it
slogs that full ball outside off to deep midwicket, where Shakib runs to his right to stop that
another one which is a near yorker outside off, as Iyer lobs that to deep midwicket. They think about two, but the quick throw keeps that to a single
yorker length ball on off, and drilled to deep midwicket with the ball angling into him. Rapid two runs grabbed

whacks that between long-on and deep midwicket! The latter fielder, Tripathi, thought he had a chance after scampering to his left, but doesn't get a hand. The ball was full and in the slot on off, and Iyer slammed that to the on side
bowls with a change of pace, and full and a touch wide of off. Swung away across the line to deep midwicket after clearing his front leg
looks to hoick that behind the wicket but the ball takes his front pad after pitching on a good length on middle and leg
taps at this full and wide ball outside off to short third man
whips this good length ball on middle to fine leg

and Hetmyer is run-out! There was no run there, never! Iyer cuts this short delivery wide of off to Iyer at point, who throws bang to the keeper, who is close to the stumps to hammer the bails, with Hetmyer easily pretty short of his crease
the ball keeps low! Good length on middle, and he makes room with his back leg outside leg, but the ball strikes him on his back pad after almost rolling over
pushes at that fullish ball outside off, and gets a single to long-on
bowls shortish and wide of off. Left alone, and wide called
whacked away, and six more! Gets this one in the slot and right in that fullish length on off, as he hangs deep in his crease to cream that swing over deep square leg for the second six of the over
dances around by first stepping across and then backing away, as Ferguson bowls good length and a touch wide of off. He skips in the crease while finally slashing it to deep point
beaten outside off! Back of a length and a touch wide of off at 146kph, as Iyer misses his little tickle
a slight fumble at short fine leg by diving to his right, but no extra run conceded. And the fielder is Varun. Hetmyer looks to hoick that fuller ball on off, but mistimes it

backs away, and just clears fine leg with that six! Heaves at that good length ball on middle, with his front leg out of the way and him playing from deep in his crease. A man was there on the fence, but the ball just about went over him
turns away that back of a length ball outside off to fine leg, as Mavi scampers to his right to cut that off
goes slogging at this full ball outside off and plays across the line, as the ball ends up at deep midwicket
much fuller on off, and clipped to deep midwicket with the closed face of the bat
lashes out at this short and wide ball outside off. His bottom hand is off, as the ball is skied and taken at point, but it doesn't matter

Gill takes a brilliant catch at long-on! But, but, but... the umpire checks for the no-ball, as replays show Varun's foot is just inside outside the line. It is given not out after a long delay and a number of replays. Hetmyer, who had gone back and was sitting in the dressing room already, rushes back smiling and punching the gloves of his partner. He fetches that full ball outside off, and goes down on his back knee to try and swing that away to the on side. But the ball doesn't come off well, as Gill has to go low after taking a few steps forward to take it. The ball for once seemed to have been popping out of his hands, but was safe in the end. And all this, for nothing eventually since it is a no-ball
fullish in length on middle, and he closes the bat face to clip that to deep square leg. Quick two is gobbled
bowls good length again and on off. Pushed to long-on from deep in his crease
goes for the reverse-sweep to this good length ball wide of off, but is beaten
pulls his length back a touch, as Hetmyer blocks this good length ball on off
short delivery again, but this pitches closer to off and angles in. Rides the bounce to dab at that to point pretty close to his body
clips this good length ball on off to deep square leg after playing from across off stump
bowls short of a length outside off, as Hetmyer dabs at that to third man a touch away from his body

bagged by mid-off, and Pant departs! Again Pant backs away, as Ferguson bowls back of a length outside off. Pant loses his bottom hand as he attempts to pull at that, but the ball seemed to have bounced more than he expected. The ball takes off from his top edge, and finds Tripathi, who has to take a few steps to his right to complete that catch
makes room and skips down, but can only flash at that good length ball outside off to mid-off on the bounce
bowls this pretty full and just outside off, as Pant clips that along the ground to long-on
tickles this good length ball wide of off to short third man
short of a length on middle and off, and cut away to point after making room
misfield at fine leg by Mavi, and that allows a boundary! Pant sweeps this full ball on middle pretty powerfully, as Mavi slips after running to his right
makes room, as Varun bowls good length outside leg while following him. Tapped toward point

very good take by Shakib diving forward at backward point! Varun almost bowls that from back of the hand, and goes fullish and a touch wide of off. Dhawan is down the track early with the intention of slamming that away to the on side after also backing away a little, but his bottom hand is off, as the ball balloons after taking his outside edge
comes down the pitch again, but Mavi bowls shortish on middle as Dhawan punches that to mid-off

lands just short of Iyer running forward at long-on! Iyer pushes at that without foot movement, as the ball is full and on off, with the bat turning in his hands. For once, he even almost never bothered to look where the ball was going
cramps him for room, as Mavi bowls back of a length outside off and gets it to dart back in. Iyer taps back at that
chips at that full delivery outside off to deep midwicket, where Gill runs to his left and lands his throw bang at the stumps at the bowler's end. But Dhawan is comfortably in
skips down after making room, but can only lob that fullish ball on leg to deep midwicket with the closed face of the bat
bowls fullish and just outside off. Driven with the closed face of the bat to long-on after playing slightly from across off
fuller and a touch wide of off. Slashed to deep point from deep in his crease
goes for the sweep to this full ball outside off, and again plays right where deep midwicket is placed
drives this very full ball outside off to deep point
and this keeps very low! Good length on leg, and scoots between Iyer's legs
goes for the pull to this short ball on middle and leg, which is turning in. But he gets a bottom edge close to his pads as the ball stays low
bowls short of a length and wide of off. Dhawan fetches it away from his body, and pulls to deep midwicket
good length again and just outside off. He clips, but straight to the man at midwicket
short of a length ball on off, and Iyer rides the bounce to tap at that

looks to loft the first ball on a full length outside off, and that lands at deep point, where the man was running to his right to cut that off. Extra cover also gave the chase after turning around and running back, but the ball landed somewhere in between them

the leg stump is uprooted! Stoinis makes room to this back of a length ball on middle, which is angling in after being bowled with a cross seam. But he gets a bottom edge as he looks to slash at that forcefully, and the ball crashes into leg stump. So Stoinis' comeback with the bat doesn't last long
slower ball, and he mistimes his hoick. Slightly back of a length outside off, and Dhawan gets a top edge as the ball flies to third man
Dhawan dances down after making room to this full ball outside off, but ends up pushing it back to the bowler
shortish in length, and wide of off. Reaches out to slash that to deep point
fuller and on off, clipped toward deep midwicket

appeal for stumping, and the umpire goes upstairs! The ball kept low and turned into Stoinis, as he misses his heave to the on side after the ball pitched on a good length on leg. Replays show his back leg is grounded as Karthik whips off the bails, and so he is safe
pushes forward at this full ball on off, and plays right to the man at cover
lap-sweeps this full ball on leg by going down on his back knee off stump. Fine leg runs and slides to his right to cut that off
goes for the sweep to this full ball on middle, and finds fine leg
punches this full toss to long-off.
chipped down the ground, no timing whatsoever. Rolls to long-off
steered to deep cover
swings hard and finds the gap between deep midwicket and long-on! Dhawan fetched the slog sweep from way outside off.
steps out and drills this down the ground, nearly bisected both men, good work by Venkatesh Iyer who put his boot out to stop that and save two runs
driven hard to long-off
works this down to long-on. The strangle is on.
this one keeps coming back in off a length outside off, bunted wide of point
this time he looks to steer it wide of slip but is beaten by the extra bounce
nearly chopped on!  It's the slowness of the surface, he was looking to work it through square leg but got a thickish inside edge.
skids back in from round the wicket, Dhawan beaten by the fizz as he gets an inside edge onto the pad
makes room and slaps this off a length to cover
crashes this cut straight to deep point
stands tall and toe-ends this punch to cover
slips this down leg, DK with a half-stop with the dive but they don't scoot a bye.
hits the hard length once again, Stoinis tries to make room by getting besides the line but can't push it past cover
hits the deck hard, extra bounce off a length as Stoinis straight bats this to short midwicket
nips back in off a length outside off, solidly defended
length ball on leg, Dhawan tucks it into the leg side
works this down to long-on again as they jog the single, 11 off it.
flat-bats this shortish delivery to a straight'ish long-on
works it down to long-on
punched to sweeper cover
clean strike to beat wide long-off! Too much flight that time, got underneath the length as he backed away and pumped it over.
stumping missed! Sees Dhawan stepping out and fires this down leg, Dhawan was off balance but DK couldn't grab the ball cleanly.
backs away to slap it over the infield, gets a thick inside edge that rolls into the leg side. Didn't get to the pitch and blindly tried to smack that.
right on top of the bounce as he tucks this to square leg. Slow going for the Capitals.
tucks this into the midwicket region for a quick single
and another miss! That one bowled on a length at 148kph, Dhawan steps out to slap it over point but is beaten. Keeps low again
beaten by the skid off the pitch! Looks to punch through the covers but this one nips back in and keeps a touch ow to beat the inside edge
short ball angling in from wide of the crease, Stoinis mistimes the pull past square leg
steered down to square third man
shortish and angling in, punched to long-on
nicely forward as he bunts it into the off side
this one keeps coming back in with the arm, Stoinis squirts this to square leg and is off the mark
shortish on the stumps, keeps a touch low, pushed back down the pitch
punched back to the bowler

Shaw done in by one that skids back in to beat the inside edge. Shaw was looking to push it into the off side but played down the wrong line because he didn't pick the googly. Dhawan asked to get on his bike.
lunges forward and defends back
whips this wide of short fine for an easy single
driven hard to wide long-off as they jog the single
swept again for six more!  That boundary behind square on the leg side is just 60 metres. Another premeditated sweep and Dhawan picked the bones out of it.
swept over deep square leg! Juicy full toss angling in, perhaps it slipped out of his hand, and Dhawan took full toll of that
beaten by one that skids through to beat Dhawan's drive
slows it down as he tosses it up outside off, Shaw mistimes this sweep to square leg
swept from outside off to deep square, no timing but Dhawan's off the mark
flatter and fuller delivery drifting in, punched to long-off
swept hard, but straight to square leg.
cuts and threads the gap between point and short third! Delightfully done. Shakib understandably drops short, Shaw makes room and crashes this into the gap.
he's walloped this to Dubai! Steps out, the ball is drifting in and he simply swings through the line to hammer this out of the ground at deep midwicket. 90-metre hit.
darts back in off the seam to hit him on the pad, drifting down leg.  Dhawan yet to get off the mark after seven deliveries, pressure building
steps out to scythe this over point but is beaten as Lockie digs this into the pitch
beaten as he lands a zippy short of length ball outside off. Dhawan was looking to flay that through point, cramped for room
lifter into middle, Shaw is rushed into his defensive stroke as he turns this into the leg side for a single. 142kph
beats the bat, good comeback! Shorter in length outside off, Shaw beaten as he tries to run this down to third man
overpitched and crashed through the covers! Don't bowl there to Shaw, at 141kph, it's fodder for the young man.
tight line on the stumps, Dhawan can only push it back to Shakib. Terrific first over
nice flight as he lands this on off, Dhawan is well forward as he defends
steps out, Shakib shortens his length, tucked into the leg side
floats this gently on middle and off, Dhawan defends back
terrific half-stop at point by Nitish Rana! Threw himself full-length to his left to intercept this cut. Saved three
floats one a touch short, Shaw slaps this straight to extra cover

pumped over the bowler's head! Knight Riders make the final. Capitals are eliminated. Gets one on a good length and wide off off, and hammers a blow back for a powerful six to seal the deal. Cool, calm and collected. Cracked away to shatter Capitals' hopes.

and taken at long-off! Damn! Ashwin gets two in two. He is on a hat-trick. But more than that, Capitals still remain afloat. He bowls with a wide-arm action, and goes full on off. Narine came down the track to try and clear the rope, but toe-ended the shot to lob that right where Axar sat

walks across off trying to scoop, but the ball strikes his back pad! Ashwin is up in a celebr-appeal, and it is given! Oh my, where is this going? The ball was full on middle and off, and replays show the ball would have crashed into middle and off. Bang!
goes sweeping to this full ball outside leg after playing by making room, but the ball hits his back thigh
pulled away to long-on's right, as Ashwin bowls short and wide of off

chopped on! What is going on here? Another Knight Riders batter succumbs. This is a good length ball wide of off, which Morgan looks to hoick away, but gets a bottom edge on to his stumps, which are lit up after the ball lands there on the bounce. Nortje is all pumped up after that, as he leaves his side with a glimmer of hope in the final over
goes slashing at this full and wide ball away from his body, but misses. Pant appeals for a caught behind, but doesn't get any support from his team-mates
dot ball! Pushed to cover, where it is Axar now. Morgan makes room and skips down, as Nortje bowls fullish on middle and leg
pulls at this hard length ball on off to long-on for a single
strikes his back pad to arouse some excitement, but that is not leg before for sure. The ball was very full on leg, as the batter got his front leg out of the way and got an inside edge on to his pad

misfield at cover, and that allows two! Iyer the fielder there. Back of a length ball on off, and Tripathi just punched that off the back foot. Ah, would have been a dot ball otherwise had Iyer not missed

the middle and off stumps are dislodged! Rabada bowls back of a length just outside off, and with seam up. Karthik looks to hoick that away to the on side, but gets an inside edge. There is life left in this game yet, as Capitals take it deep
finally gets one away. Slashes at this short ball just outside off, and plays to deep point
four dots in a row now. Dances down to this good length ball outside off, but finds the man at cover, who stops with a little movement to his right
another dot ball. This is a touch fuller and outside off, and again stays a little low as he can't bat on ball
good change of pace, and beats the batter! Tripathi looks to pull that back of a length ball on off, but misses, as the ball goes over the stumps
sharp movement into the batter! Pitches on a good length on middle and darts back in while keeping low. Tapped from deep in his crease
short and wide of off, and with change of pace. Karthik thinks about jabbing at that, but lets it go as the ball dies to Pant
yorker length on middle, and clipped to midwicket with the closed face of the bat. Misfield there, but no run conceded

pocketed by Pant! Gill gets an outside edge to this full ball slightly wide of off, as he plays with a horizontal bat. The ball takes the top edge and takes off, as Pant leaps a little high and to his right, leaving the gloves open for the ball to arrive comfortably
he too dances down, as he bunts this good length ball on off to the left of the man at mid-off
skips down to this short ball on middle and leg, before playing that to deep square leg with a short-arm pull
goes flashing at this short and wide ball outside off, but doesn't get any connection

short-arm pull, and taken at long leg! The ball takes off after pitching short outside off, as Rana pulls from deep in his crease and with his back leg outside off. He is not quite able to ride the bounce, as the ball comes off the higher side of the bat to fly to Hetmyer
much fuller on middle and off, and driven to long-on with his bat right in front of pad
pulls handsomely, and clears long-on! Nortje digs it in short and just outside off, as Gill hangs deep in his crease to use his bottom hand to pummel that away off the front foot
slower ball, and a dipping full-toss just outside off. Pushed down to long-on
back of a length and just outside off. He punches at that with the closed face of the bat, as midwicket dives to his left but doesn't get a hand. A single down to long-on
full delivery a touch wide of off, and flashed to point on the bounce
slower ball, and slightly back of a length outside off. Dabbed to mid-off, who throws at the bowler's end to allow an overthrow. Dhawan was the fielder, leaving Pant unimpressed
goes for the pull, but gets a bottom edge, as the ball drops close to his off stump. Short delivery on off from Avesh, and mistimed by Gill
driven to the left of third man, as he plays at this full ball wide of off
beaten on the flash! Goes poking at the back of a length ball outside off, while playing without foot movement, and doesn't connect
guides this fullish ball outside off to third man

a sitter dropped by Ashwin at third man! Rana goes slicing at this fullish ball wide of off, but the ball flies off his outside edge. All Ashwin has to do is go low exactly where he is standing, but the ball pops out after kissing his palm
short of a length on middle, and Gill misses his sweep as the ball hits his body
slashes this full ball wide of off to deep point while playing away from his body, as Smith gives the chase to his right
fires that bang over the bowler's head! Nearly goes down on his back knee to launch that full ball on off, and gets the result with that maximum
full and straight on off, and driven to long-off with the full face of the bat
bowls full and wide of off, as it slashed to deep point away from his body to raise the side's hundred
rammed to long-on, as he skips down to this very full ball on middle and off
this is fuller on off, and Rana closes his bat ace to tap that toward midwicket
pulls this short of a length ball outside off to deep square leg
punches this good length ball outside off to deep point after playing from deep in his crease
bowls back of a length on middle and off, as Rana dabs that toward point. Gill wants a single, but is sent back

nabbed at deep square leg! The sound off the bat first gave the impression that it was probably going all the way, but looked like it was timed far too well. He makes room and clears his front leg, as Rabada bowls shortish on middle and leg stump. Iyer pulled, but the ball landed right where the substitute fielder Smith was stationed

outside edge, and four to third man! Swings wildly to this slower ball, which is full and wide of off. But he plays without foot movement and away from his body, as the ball takes  faint edge for four behind

strikes him on the front pad after Gill comes down the track, and Axar appeals for leg before. Gill missed his clip to this fullish ball on middle and leg, which skid on with the arm. The ball rolled over to the off side after hitting him
sweeps this low full-toss on middle to deep midwicket
goes down on his back knee to half-sweep this fullish ball on off to deep midwicket
very full on middle, and pushed back to the bowler
dabs at this fullish ball outside off to short third man, and gets to his third fifty this season. Just 38 balls for this one
drills this very full ball on leg to long-on after coming down the track
full-toss on off, and that is just leaned into to drive to point. Nortje gets away with that
takes pace off, and bowls full and at the stumps. Gill comes down a step before pushing it to long-on after making room
bowls a near yorker-length ball on middle, as Iyer clips that to deep midwicket with the closed face of the bat

five wides! Pant dives to his right, but doesn't manage a glove. Iyer again makes room, as Nortje follows him to bowl short and wide of leg. The ball is too wide to be pulled, and so that is a gift for Knight Riders
backs away, and slices that with his bottom hand off to deep backward point! The ball is full on the stumps, as making room allows him the room to swing freely, albeit not quite in control
the bat face opens last moment, as he leans to dab at this full ball on off to the man at cover
pushes this full delivery on off to mid-off, as the bat turns in his hands
drifting into middle and leg, tucked to deep midwicket
driven crisply, good stop at extra cover by Shaw
width outside off, punched to Dhawan at sweeper cover
yorker-length on leg, squeezed into the leg side, Axar hares across to stop that
fired wide again, Iyer reaches this and cuts to point
fired away from Iyer's hitting arc, wide called
magnificent strike! That's been clobbered over deep midwicket and it's the freeflowing swing through the line.
short-arm jabs this to wide long-on, risky second made possible in the end because the throw is wide.
drops short and is lucky to get away with that as Gill finds point
pushed to long-off as they jog the single
keeps a touch low as Iyer punches back, good stop off his own bowling.
steps out to drive, gets a thick inside edge to short fine
slips this down leg, Pant gets across swiftly to take that
muscled down the ground, but can't beat Dhawan at long-on, flat hit to him.
lifter off a length on off, turned to the leg side.
sliced over the infield, on the bounce to Ashwin at square third man
nip-backer on middle and leg, keeps a touch low, tucked to fine leg
gets a thick bottom-edge but doesn't carry to Pant. Was looking to back cut that
punches this length ball on the up to sweeper cover, two more. They're strolling through
down the ground, lofted nicely. Hetmyer at long-on stop that
nudged into the gap at midwicket, Nortje had some work to do running in from the deep, excellent running
steps out and whips this down to long-on
lands a carrom ball from wide of the crease but the length is on the shorter side, tucked to deep square
nicely tossed up on middle and leg, worked with the angle towards deep midwicket
arm-ball that skids back in from around the wicket, defended solidly
grip and turn, bit of a leading edge into the gap at point. No run though.
beaten by one that angles in and holds its line. Kept low too.
low full toss, Iyer opens the bat face to ease this down to third man
whipped to deep midwicket, two more into the kitty to raise the half-century stand
drops it gently into the off side as they pinch a quick single
cut hard, down to deep point
ah, that is delightful timing! What a find this Venky Iyer. Avesh slips in a length ball on middle and leg, Iyer uses his wrists to whip this past midwicket. The ball kept gathering momentum.
whips this from outside off towards deep square, aggressive running to complete the second. KKR cruising.
slips this short of length delivery too far wide outside off, Gill looks to cut and misses. Pant has to put in a dive to stop that.
tucks this to short fine, may have come off the pad. Yeah, off the thigh pad.
dropped him!  Iyer got this high on the bat and it popped back to Rabada who got both his hands to it before grassing it. Should've been taken.
slips this length ball down leg, wide called. More frustration
how easily did he execute that?  He isn't stepping out to a club bowler, but a world-class fast bowler. Walks into the stroke as he nonchalantly wallops this over long-on. What a clean strike
neatly tucked to short fine, but they pinch a quick single even as Ashwin fires a direct hit
nearly chipped this to midwicket! Gill was looking to whip this off his hip but checked his shot as this stopped on him.
walks into the stroke as he pushes it to long-off
fired full on leg stump, Iyer works it down to long-on
sharp turn from outside off, this one rolls back off the inside edge. May have stopped on him a touch
he's clobbered that over deep midwicket! Onto the roof. Stepped out and hit this with the turn. Lovely
turns this towards midwicket as they jog the single
drifting into middle and leg, tucked to square leg
slower length ball outside off, guided behind point for a single to keep strike
beaten as he looks to cut hard
pushes this to mid-off for a quick single
plays the short-arm jab quite delightfully into the gap at deep midwicket. Hetmyer with a fumble after doing all the hard work in getting around to the ball, that gave away the third.
beats the underedge as he shapes to cut this short and wide delivery. This one kept low
steered down to third man
punches to mid-on as they punch a quick single. Iyer was deep inside the crease as he played that so had a extra couple of yards to cover.
skiddy length delivery on middle, punched down to long-on
steps out and whips this full ball to deep midwicket
swept backward of square, one bounce four! Ashwin experiments yet again, low-armish again, lands this short, Iyer gets down on one knee and sweeps him up and over.
low-armish delivery on middle and leg, punched wide of midwicket
driven hard towards wide long-off, should've been two but Gill was ambling across
hits him high on the bat as he shapes to pull, completely rushed into the shot. Rolls towards square leg and Iyer is off the mark. Good comeback after being picked for a boundary first ball.
floats a length ball across the left-hander, punches this straight to point
big appeal as Venky is rapped on the pad but this pitched way outside leg. Delhi don't bother reviewing.
length ball on leg-stump, hit back to the bowler. Came off the top part of the bat, made a thhhhhud. Good ball
shortens his length this time, Gill runs this down to third man
crashed through the covers! Ah, so delicious. Gift of a half-volley
